preconditions.description: N, D, U, and Q are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= H[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each shaman's altitude H_i is within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] < N and 0 <= B[i] < N and A[i] != B[i] for i in range(U))
preconditions.description: Each trust change involves distinct shamans within bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N and 0 <= v <= U for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each query involves valid shaman indices and day index.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(abs(H[x_prime] - H[y_prime]) for x_prime in trusted_friends_x for y_prime in trusted_friends_y)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the minimum distance between trusted friends of x and y on day v.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if any(x_prime == y_prime for x_prime in trusted_friends_x for y_prime in trusted_friends_y) else return_value
postconditions.description: If any trusted friend of x is also a trusted friend of y, the distance is 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 10**9 if len(trusted_friends_x) == 0 or len(trusted_friends_y) == 0 else return_value
postconditions.description: If either x or y has no trusted friends, the distance is 10^9.
